Nova Post is an all-in-one postal service for all your international parcel delivery needs. Our mobile app has been designed to streamline sending and receiving parcels. With a variety of easy-to-use tools at your fingertips, we provide a seamless experience for sending and receiving packages, making online payments, maintaining a customer profile, filing claims, tracking deliveries and more.

Easily Create and Track Parcels
Create new parcels effortlessly, providing all the necessary shipping details and tracking your deliveries in real-time - from dispatch until they safely reach their destination.

Send and Receive Packages at the Parcel Locker
Nova Post simplifies parcel handling by allowing you to send and receive parcels through our secure parcel locker network. Forget about wasting time in post office lines - we are transforming your local parcel locker into a convenient and efficient delivery hub.

Pay for Delivery Services Online
Say goodbye to cash and card payments - Nova Post's integrated payment feature ensures secure online transactions, enabling you to pay for your shipping with ease and confidence. It's convenient and only a few taps away.

Manage Your Customer Profile
Creating and managing your customer profile in the app has never been easier. Store your personal information, addresses, and preferences, ensuring a tailored experience with every interaction. Nova Post simplifies the parcel creation process by pre-filling your details every time you create a parcel.

Find the Nearest Branch
Need to locate your nearest Nova Post office? Our integrated mapping feature provides real-time information on the closest branches. Easily build your route and enjoy dropping off or collecting parcels quickly.

Receive Notifications About the Status of the Parcel
Stay informed with our tracking and notification system. From sending to delivery, you'll receive real-time updates on your parcel's status, location and expected arrival.

Faster Postal Services with Barcode Scanning
Spend less time picking up your parcel at the branch with our barcode time-saving scanning feature. Simply scan the barcode within the app at the post office to provide our team with the necessary customer information with just a few taps.

Share Detailed Information About the Parcel
Share comprehensive delivery information with the recipients directly through the app, ensuring all relevant details are readily available. This feature promotes transparent and efficient interactions between senders and receivers.

File a Claim in the Application
We understand that sometimes things don't go as planned. That's why we created a convenient in-app claim-filing feature. Address your concerns or issues, and trust our team to handle the rest efficiently and smoothly.

Nova Post always focuses on providing secure, efficient, and user-friendly solutions, redefining postal services globally. Experience the future of parcel delivery with Nova Post – ship, track and receive parcels with confidence and ease, both on and offline. 

Want to know more about Nova Post? Follow us at www.novapost.com
